show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/GcAY2w
show.description: In a land ruled by three Gurukuls, a warrior sets out to awaken the seven chakras and prove his strength. Caught between two rival princesses, he uncovers his true identity and must face a higher power to claim his destiny.
